exposure: Mechanical labor induction with balloon placement without malpresentation
Mechanical labor induction with balloon placement resulting in malpresentation
Fetal station at the start of labor induction
cohort: 23,344 individuals who underwent labor induction (pharmacological or mechanical) at a single tertiary medical center.
finding: Several risk factors for fetal malpresentation following mechanical labor induction were identified, including older age, higher body mass index, higher parity, polyhydramnios, higher fetal station at induction start, and earlier gestational age, but a prediction model using these variables was not sufficiently accurate.
gest_age: Earlier gestational age at delivery was associated with increased risk of malpresentation
